response.sql:
WITH per_media_type AS (
    SELECT
        m.Name AS media_type_name,
        AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / t.Milliseconds) AS avg_bytes_per_millisecond
    FROM Track AS t
    JOIN MediaType AS m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId
    WHERE t.Bytes > 10323804
    GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name
), overall_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_bytes_per_millisecond) AS avg_of_media_type_averages
    FROM per_media_type
)
SELECT
    p.media_type_name,
    p.avg_bytes_per_millisecond,
    p.avg_bytes_per_millisecond - o.avg_of_media_type_averages AS above_overall_average
FROM per_media_type AS p
CROSS JOIN overall_average AS o
WHERE p.avg_bytes_per_millisecond > o.avg_of_media_type_averages;

assumptions.assumption: “Pass a cutoff of 10,323,804 bytes” means Track.Bytes is strictly greater than the cutoff; tracks with NULL Bytes are excluded by the comparison.
